title: Are You 'Most Done?
author: Russell Owen
notes: The Caller's Box 2842, permission: full. The Caller's Box's own notes: "Hey can straighten out as it proceeds. Dance begins with same neighbors as in the hey." The hey is on the right diagonal. **Which four dancers that is, is not settled**: the star left 7/8 leaves the minor set standing on a diagonal, and the record reads the hey as that set's own — `axis: "diagonal"`, the lane at whatever angle the four really make. The other reading is the couple across the seam (`"group": "shadow-pair"`, which becket already partitions), and no measurement here decided between them. Q12's ruling is a fixed diagonal first: the lane runs at the angle the four dancers really make and does not straighten. Lisa Greenleaf's alternate B2 (#4700) is in the source transcript and is not encoded; it is the same concurrent call with a shoulder round and a shift in place of the allemande and the loop.
